item.text: The loader currently skips array conversion when `_version` is missing or nonnumeric, and it no longer copies legacy `_theme` into `_themeId`. I’ll make migration detect those stored shapes, then add regression tests for both cases.

The migration fix and regression tests are in place. The tests cover legacy `_theme`, array credentials with missing or nonnumeric `_version`, and a mismatched array shape at the current version. `testclient` and `types` are running.

item.text:
Fixed the DeviceConfig migration cases identified in review. Loading now preserves legacy `_theme` as `_themeId` and converts array `_credentials` even when `_version` is missing or nonnumeric. Added regression tests that also check repeat initialization avoids unnecessary writes.

`npm run types` passed, `npm run testclient` passed (3,093 assertions), and `git diff --check` passed. No remaining failures or test environment problems.
